skillsLead: What the agent can do besides reading the corpus.
toolsLead: What it may look up and what it may run.
toolsEnvHint: Two capabilities that touch the session's own folder.
credentialsLead: Credentials belong to this agent alone; revoking one stops this service and leaves your own sign-in alone.
endpointHint: POST here with a credential from the list, naming one bound knowledge source.
behaviorLead: What makes an answer acceptable. The runtime checks these; the prompt does not.
temperatureHint: How varied the wording is. Lower is steadier and closer to the source; higher is more varied. Answers that must cite sources work well at 0–0.3.
retrievalLivesOnKb: How much to retrieve, and whether to rerank, are settings of the knowledge source.
topPHint: Samples only from the more likely candidates; lower is more conservative. Usually tuned instead of temperature, not alongside it.
maxTokensHint: Ceiling for the answer length. Unset uses the default limit.
reasoningEffortHint: How much effort goes into reasoning. Higher is slower and usually more accurate. Applies only while thinking mode is on.
samplingPresetHint: How steady the wording is. Picking one fills the two fields below; both stay editable.
previewContextNote: Everything after "Context from the knowledge base" is filled in with the passages retrieved for the question, so it appears as a placeholder here.
previewAgentsMdEmpty: No instructions written, so no AGENTS.md is produced.
previewFailed: Could not read the model input.
previewLead: Two texts reach the model: the system prompt is sent with every answer; AGENTS.md is written into the session workspace and read on demand.
agentsMdPlaceholder:
# Conventions
Quote the document title when you answer.
previewLegend: ① instruction　② AGENTS.md (appended as <workspace_conventions>)　③ skill descriptions　④ answer policy　⑤ retrieved passages (filled per question)
instructionLead: The body of the system prompt, sent with every answer. Empty uses the built-in instruction.
instructionPlaceholder: Answer questions from the material bound below, and name the document you answer from.
agentsMdLead: Workspace conventions. Appended to the system prompt as agent memory; not written as a session file.
agentsMdNote: Sent with every answer; no file is created in the conversation directory.
profileLead: Identity and two texts: the instruction forms the system prompt; AGENTS.md is injected as memory and written to the workspace.
skillsPackagesLead: Installable skills: a procedure plus optional scripts, written into the prompt once installed.
skillsInstalledLead: These skills contribute their instructions to the system prompt.
skillsRegistryLead: From the workforce skill registry; one skill can be installed on several agents.
skillsWhereToManage: Write and publish skills in Workforce → Skills.
toolsSwitchesLead: A switch decides which tools appear in the model's tool list. What each tool does is the tool definition's job.
sandboxAllowCommandsHint: One command per line. These only add to the built-in allow list and cannot remove from it. Empty keeps the built-in list.
identityLead: The name callers and audit see, and a description of what this service answers. Both open the system prompt.
descriptionHint: One line on what it can answer. It joins the prompt as part of "You are <name>. <description>".
previewNeedsSource: Bind a knowledge source first; the prompt is built through it.
promptTabLead: What the model receives on every answer, shown as the blocks it is assembled from. Read-only.
promptSource_conventions: AGENTS.md from Profile, appended to the prompt as memory
promptSource_skills: Skill packages installed on the Skills tab
promptSource_tools: Capabilities enabled on the Tools tab
promptSource_policy: Answer policy from the Behaviour tab
promptSource_context: Filled in from the knowledge source per question
promptAgentsMdLead: The block appended to the system prompt as agent memory; it is no longer written into the conversation workspace.
promptFullLead: The single system message sent to the model, verbatim; retrieved passages are filled in per question and shown as a placeholder here.
agentsMdHint: Workspace conventions, appended to the system prompt as agent memory. Not written into the conversation workspace: every session has its own directory, and a copy there would be a second source of truth.
toolsDefinitionNote: These are the tool definitions the model receives — the same text, not a summary.
toolsCatalogFailed: Could not read the tool catalogue. Try again shortly.
sandboxPolicy: {{count}} built-in commands, {{timeout}}s per run; the list below can only add to them.
toolsCatalogLead: What the runtime provides, what each capability needs, and where its limits are. Read-only: enabling one is decided on that agent’s Tools tab.
toolsCatalogAllowHint: Shared by every agent. An individual agent’s own list can only add to them.
toolsPolicyLine: Runs in the {{cwd}}; only {{writable}} is writable; {{timeout}}s per run.
toolsNoneSelected: No capability selected — the defaults are used instead. Tick one to choose explicitly.
sandboxAllowCommandsHintWithBuiltin: One command per line. {{count}} commands are always allowed; this list only adds to them.
toolsBindOnlyWhenOn: Turn it on to bind what it reads.
toolsAllowlistScope: The command allow list constrains {{tool}} only. Running Python is not constrained by it: code is not a command line.
modelsLead: Numbers can only come from the models bound here. Binding one grants reading its metrics and tables.
groupsLead: Graph questions can only walk the groups bound here.
knowledgeTabLead: What this agent may read: the corpus it answers from, the metrics it may query, and the graph it may walk. All three are knowledge, in three shapes.
webSearchConnectorLead: The one search connector this agent may use when it enables Web search. Two providers answer the same question, so which one is a deployment decision, not the model’s.
webSearchConnectorNone: No enabled search connector exists. Add one under Connectors first.
sandboxAllowCommandsHelp: What is worth adding (and what it costs)
sandboxAllowGroupFilesWhy: when a script needs a directory structure. Writing a file already creates its folders, so this is about moving and removing.
sandboxAllowGroupArchivesWhy: when the knowledge base receives zips or tarballs. They write, and they can write outside the conversation folder.
sandboxAllowGroupTextWhy: when a file must be changed in place. Both can start a shell of their own (sed -e, awk system()).
sandboxAllowGroupCodeWhy: usually unnecessary: run_python already runs code, and this only puts it in the shell as well.
sandboxAllowGroupVcsWhy: a git alias starting with ! runs any command, so this widens the boundary more than it looks.
requireCitationsHint: Once a tool has run, an answer with no sources is refused. A question with no tool call is not affected.
requireCitationsRequire: Refuse an answer with no sources
maxAnswerCharsHint: Characters. Empty means no limit; a longer answer is cut and marked in warnings.
schemaLookupHint: Asked of the model in the prompt, not checked afterwards.
answerPolicyPromptOnly: “Unknown measure” and “look before you query” are written into the prompt: the runtime cannot parse a question for a measure name without guessing. Grounding, citations and the length limit are enforced.
refusalLead: What a caller reads when a policy refuses, and where they go next. One wording for the API and the chat.
refusalTextHint: Empty uses the built-in wording. Applies to enforced refusals: unsourced numbers, or no citations.
refusalTextPlaceholder: This question cannot be answered from the material available.
refusalContactHint: A support address, a ticket URL, an internal number. Returned as refusal.contact.
pausedMessageHint: Returned with the 503 as AGENT_PAUSED. Empty uses the built-in line.
pausedMessagePlaceholder: This service is temporarily unavailable. Please try again later.

credentialsPage.title: Keys
credentialsPage.lead: Every key that can call an agent, and when it was last used. Create one on the agent it opens.
credentialsPage.empty: No keys yet. Open an agent and issue one from its Credentials tab.
credentialsPage.revokeConfirm: Revoke {{prefix}}… for {{agent}}? Anything calling with it stops working immediately.

queueRefusals: Put refusals in the Operations queue
queueRefusalsHint: On: every refusal becomes a queue item, so someone can look at the ones that were wrong. A new agent refuses a lot; turn this off once the answers have settled.
serviceLead: Whether this agent answers at all, and how to take it out of service.
pauseHint: Paused keeps the configuration, the sources and the keys; callers get a 503 with the paused message.
deleteAgentHint: Its keys stop working immediately and the configuration is gone. There is no restore.
assembledPromptLead: What the model is given, block by block — each block names the tab it comes from.
promptSource_bound_data: The semantic models and ontology groups this agent is bound to, from the Knowledge tab
